about.title: About SureCure Visit
about.lead: A marketplace for healthcare at home: doctors, laboratories, scheduled ambulance operators and caretakers, each verified and each serving the areas they say they serve.
about.missionBody: Getting to a clinic is hard for many people: after a hospital stay, with an older parent, or with a busy family. SureCure Visit makes it possible to find verified providers who come to you, see their prices up front and request care in your own language.

model.independent: Providers are independent professionals and organisations. They set their own prices, services and areas.
model.choice: You choose the provider. Nothing is assigned automatically.
model.acceptance: Providers accept or decline each request themselves.
model.verified: Only providers whose documents and coverage we have reviewed can be booked.

not.emergency: We are not an emergency service. In an emergency, call 108.
not.employer: We are not the employer of the providers listed.
not.ai: We do not use AI to diagnose, match or accept bookings.

about.teamBody: Meet the three leaders behind SureCure Visit.

ourStory.title: Our story
ourStory.lead: SureCure Visit started from a simple idea: when someone needs care, it should be possible to bring trustworthy care to them.
ourStory.purposeBody: Travelling for a consultation, a blood test or a check-up is often the hardest part of getting care. Bringing verified providers to the home, at a price agreed in advance, removes that step without lowering the standard of who you let in.
ourStory.englishNote: These letters are in the leaders’ own words, in English.

howItWorks.title: How SureCure Visit works
howItWorks.lead: The same steps apply to doctor visits, lab tests, scheduled ambulances and caretakers.

pin.title: Enter your PIN code
pin.body: We show only verified providers who serve your area. If there are none yet, we say so.

choose.title: Choose a provider
choose.body: Compare services, languages and prices. Browsing does not need an account.

account.title: Create your account
account.body: Before your first booking you answer a short health questionnaire. “Unknown” and “None” are valid answers.

request.title: Send a request
request.body: Pick a time and confirm the price shown. This is a request, not yet a booking.

accept.title: The provider accepts
accept.body: You are told when the provider confirms or declines. Only an accepted request is a booking.

visit.title: Receive care
visit.body: The provider comes at the agreed time. Records and reports appear in your account where available.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Create a professional account for your service type.

documents.title: Submit documents
documents.body: Identity, registration or licence where required, and the PIN codes you serve.

review.title: Review
review.body: Our team checks your documents. We may ask for changes. Approval is not guaranteed.

publish.title: Set services and prices
publish.body: Once approved, publish what you offer, where and at what price.

requests.title: Accept requests
requests.body: You decide which requests to accept.

howItWorks.paymentBody: Providers set their own prices, shown in rupees before you send a request. The price is fixed at the moment you request. Some providers collect payment after the visit. Online payment is not available yet.
howItWorks.cancelBody: Cancellation and refund terms are still being finalised. Whatever terms apply to a booking will be shown before you send the request.
howItWorks.verificationBody: Verification means our team has reviewed a provider’s identity, required registration or licence and service area. It is not a rating and not a guarantee of any outcome.
howItWorks.emergencyBody: SureCure Visit is for planned care. In an emergency, call 108.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.lead: Short answers about using SureCure Visit. If your question is not here, see the contact page.
faqPage.searchHint: Type a word such as price, cancel or PIN
faqPage.noResultsBody: Try a different word, or clear the search to see every question.

whatIs.a: A marketplace where you can find verified doctors, laboratories, scheduled ambulance operators and caretakers who serve your area, and request care at home.

coverage.a: Only PIN codes where verified providers actually operate. Enter your PIN code to see who serves it. If nobody does yet, we will tell you.

emergency.q: Can I use SureCure Visit in an emergency?
emergency.a: No. SureCure Visit is for planned care and does not dispatch emergency services. In an emergency, call 108.

browse.q: Do I need an account to look at providers?
browse.a: No. You can browse providers and prices without signing in. You need an account to send a request.

confirmed.q: Is my booking confirmed when I send a request?
confirmed.a: No. A request becomes a booking only when the provider accepts it. You will see its status in your account.

questionnaire.q: Why do I have to answer a health questionnaire?
questionnaire.a: Providers need basic health information before visiting. You answer it once before your first booking, and “Unknown” or “None” are valid answers. It is never needed to see emergency information.

price.a: Each provider sets their own price. It is shown before you send a request, and the price at the moment of your request is the one that applies.

pay.a: The payment method is shown on each booking. Some providers collect payment after the visit. Online payment is not available yet.

cancel.a: Cancellation and refund terms are still being finalised. The terms that apply will be shown before you send a request.

privacy.q: Who can see my health information?
privacy.a: Your health information is kept private and shared only with the providers involved in your care. The privacy notice, currently a draft, will describe this in full.

languages.a: The website is available in English, Telugu and Hindi. Each provider lists the languages they speak.

verify.a: Our team reviews each provider’s identity, required registration or licence and the areas they serve before they can be booked. Verification is not a rating or a guarantee of outcome.

join.q: How do I become a provider?
join.a: Sign up with a professional account for your service, submit your documents and wait for review. You can be booked only after approval.

emergency.title: In a medical emergency, call 108
emergency.lead: 108 is the emergency ambulance number in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. Calls are free.
emergency.callHint: On a phone, this starts the call. You can also dial 1 0 8 yourself.
emergency.dispatchTitle: SureCure Visit does not dispatch emergency help
emergency.dispatchBody: Our ambulance listings are for scheduled, non-emergency trips only. Booking through SureCure Visit is not a way to get emergency help.

steps.location: Tell the call handler your exact location, including a landmark.
steps.stay: Stay with the person and keep the phone line free.
steps.move: Do not move someone who may be injured unless they are in danger where they are.
steps.follow: Follow the instructions the emergency call handler gives you.
steps.door: If you can, have someone meet the ambulance at the gate or road.

emergency.disclaimer: This page is general guidance, not medical advice.
